CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, name, employee_id, designation, mobile)
  VALUES (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'employee_id',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'designation',
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'mobile'
  );
  RETURN new;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_post_office_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (TG_OP = 'INSERT') THEN
        IF NEW.last_approved_by IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, new_data, changed_by, approved_by)
            VALUES (
                NEW.id,
                'INSERT',
                row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb,
                COALESCE(NEW.last_modified_by, NEW.user_id, auth.uid()),
                NEW.last_approved_by
            );
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;

    ELSIF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE') THEN
        -- Ignore case-only capitalization updates; log only real content/PIN/delete changes
        IF (
            LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW."Address", ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD."Address", '')))
            OR LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NEW."Office", ''))) IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(OLD."Office", '')))
            OR NEW."Pin" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Pin"
            OR NEW.is_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_deleted
        ) AND NEW.last_approved_by IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, old_data, new_data, changed_by, approved_by)
            VALUES (
                NEW.id,
                'UPDATE',
                row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb,
                row_to_json(NEW)::jsonb,
                COALESCE(NEW.last_modified_by, auth.uid()),
                NEW.last_approved_by
            );
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;

    ELSIF (TG_OP = 'DELETE') THEN
        INSERT INTO public.post_offices_history (post_office_id, action, old_data, changed_by, approved_by)
        VALUES (
            OLD.id,
            'DELETE',
            row_to_json(OLD)::jsonb,
            COALESCE(OLD.last_modified_by, auth.uid()),
            OLD.last_approved_by
        );
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;

    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
CREATE TRIGGER post_offices_audit_trigger AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.post_offices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION log_post_office_history()
